title: My swings
selectHint: Tap two swings to compare them, or select swings to delete.
compareTwo: Pick exactly two swings to compare

empty.title: No swings yet
empty.text: Record or upload your first swing – it shows up here with its score and the main thing to work on.

memoryMode: ✕ Your swings are not saved in this mode (e.g. private browsing). They are gone when you close the app.

confirmDelete.text: The video, the analysis and its progress entries are deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone.

progress.intro: How often each fault showed up – oldest swing on the left.
progress.legend: Each bar is one swing. Red ✕ = fault seen (taller = stronger), green ✓ = not seen. Swings where the fault could not be checked are left out.
progress.empty: No faults found so far – or not enough swings. Keep analyzing, the curve builds up with every swing.

compareScreen.title: Compare
compareScreen.syncHint: Both swings jump to the same position. Slide to move through both swings together.
compareScreen.differentView: The two swings were filmed from different sides – most values are not comparable.
compareScreen.noValues: No values measured at this position.
compareScreen.notFound: One of the swings could not be found.
